saying: Most commenters say benchmark scores alone cannot establish real-world safety: sponsors should document per-benchmark construct validity tied to intended use, run contamination checks, use sequestered or independently held test sets, and pair benchmarking with clinical confirmation. Sponsor-developed benchmarks are accepted for novel uses, but only with locked thresholds, escrow, or independent adjudication.

disagreement.text: No material conflict appears. Commenters are working out who should hold and maintain sequestered test assets (FDA or a NIST-linked steward, another independent party, or an escrowed sponsor set) and how much construct-validity and contamination evidence sponsors must file before a benchmark can gate evaluation.
